Priya (CS): quick heads-up — compiled the last 3 weeks of customer calls into a tiny bag-of-asks. seeing a few repeating pain points and couple of feature asks from onboarding customers.
Ava (CS): +1. can you drop the raw list? i'll skim for renewal risk signals. :mag_right:
Priya (CS): pasted CSV snippet below (trimmed):
```
acct,ask,type,impact,notes
acme,per-route-billing,feature,high,blocks cost clarity for trials
velociti,embedding-expiration,bug,medium,duplicates in vector store
northbay,tenant-mgmt,feature,high,can't onboard multiple teams
```
Ava (CS): nice. top two high-impact: per-route-billing and tenant-mgmt. Both tied to renewals.
Ravi (PM): flagged per-route-billing — we have a partial design that landed on backlog. what's the main ask? single toggle per route or per-model?
Priya (CS): customer asks: 1) toggle per route to opt into detailed line-item billing; 2) export CSV with per-route breakdown. prefer quick win first.
Noah (Eng): per-route export CSV is straightforward (endpoint + scheduled job). the toggle requires console + infra changes. rough estimate: export ~2 days, toggle ~2.5 weeks.
Ava (CS): export CSV could be a good pilot for Dedicated customers on renewal cadence. low-friction and shows action.
Ravi (PM): agree. propose we put CSV export into next sprint as a shipped signal, and start scoping toggle as a Q2 epic.
Priya (CS): i'll include in the renewal playbook notes and notify the top 5 at-risk accounts with an ETA if we approve.
feedback-bot: created jira CS-4470 "per-route billing export (CS pilot)" assigned to @noah.
Noah (Eng): got it, i'll pick up a spike tomorrow to mock the export and sample payload.
Ava (CS): can we also attach 2 example customer quotes to the Jira? quick copy: "We need per-route cost visibility to decide pilot scale" and "billing diff makes renewal threshold unclear"
Priya (CS): done, added quotes + call links. tagging @ravi for prioritization.
Ravi (PM): will slot export CSV as priority-high. thanks team. can someone add an acceptance criteria list?
Noah (Eng): i'll add ACs to the ticket after the spike. rough ACs: 1) generate per-route CSV for last 30 days, 2) auth respects org scoping, 3) email link to CSV on demand, 4) logs show per-route aggregation time.
Priya (CS): perfect. i'll follow up with the 5 customers once we have the staging link. :rocket:
